package.name: kims
package.description: KIMS: Kinematics-Constrained MPPI Smoothing for UWB-IMU 6-DoF Pose Estimation. Offline evaluation of KIMS on MILUV, NTU VIRAL, UTIL and IULUI, with the first-submission EKF-RTS, particle-smoothing and SW-PGO baselines. The tools read CSV and build without ROS.
